summary: Completed C1 Explore: identified design deviations where exchange media (GitHub, Push, PR, Remote Author, Local Materializer, Worktree topology) were incorrectly written as flow rules, and defined environment-neutral logical integration boundaries. C1 defines what logical information is exchanged (Action Definition, Action Package, Action Result, ResultRef, Continuation Context, continuation boundary), who owns each fact, and Agent/Adapter/Skill power limits. C1 does not define exchange media, provider, or topology. The C1/D1 boundary is clear: C1 defines 'what information is needed for continuation', D1 defines 'when Bootstrap forms and presents these'. Supporting correction candidate docs identified for D1 (bootstrap-reference-corrections) and C1 Apply (continuation-boundary-reference, c1-d1-boundary-correction).
keyConclusions: Flowkit defines executable, verifiable, continuable logical boundaries but does not prescribe what media executors use to exchange information.
Action Package is a logical execution input view, not a fixed file package.
Action Result records what happened; Policy decides what happens next; Result must not self-advance Change or Delivery.
ResultRef must uniquely identify results, detect staleness, and not bind to a single provider.
Continuation Context is a recovery view generated from formal facts, not a new state authority.
Continuation boundary is boundary semantics, not a new entity, state, Action, or Commit type.
Review binds to reviewedResultRef (not Git-only SHA); approval invalidates when reviewed result changes.
Adapter only converts I/O; must not judge Action, skip Review, self-authorize, or become a second orchestrator.
C1 does not fix GitHub, Remote, Push, PR, Patch, ZIP, Worktree, PowerShell, local/remote, or AI provider.
C1 does not introduce Materializer, Provider Registry, Workspace Capability enumeration, or topology enumeration.
deviationsIdentified: GitHub/Remote/Push/PR written as flow rules → corrected to environment-neutral continuation boundary
Remote Author + Local Materializer elevated to formal roles → abolished; only owner/author/reviewer remain
Fixed Workspace Capability enumeration → abolished; not needed for C1 core
Fixed Worktree/Bare Remote/Remote Forge topology → abolished; Flowkit stays media-agnostic
Git Commit treated as mandatory for all continuations → separated: Git boundary ≠ continuation boundary ≠ exchange media
